inputs.name: ReportCommandService.constructor.repository
inputs.description: The persistence repository used by command workflows. Defaults to new ReportRepository(), which the constructor creates when no repository is supplied.

inputs.name: ReportCommandService.execute.argv
inputs.description: The command-line argument vector parsed to select a report operation and its flags. It must contain an operation and the flags accepted by that command; command-specific required flags are read by the selected branch.

outputs.name: ReportCommandService.execute
outputs.description: A Promise resolving to the selected command branch result. Import returns an object formed as { run: id, ...result }; other shapes are delegated to repositories or services and remain unknown.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when dispatch reaches an unsupported operation, or when import has no --run value and the format is not mira.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown when begin receives a truthy --acceptance value that is not valid JSON.
